questions.question: What was the first plague God sent on Egypt?
options: Darkness fell over all of Egypt
Swarms of frogs covered the land

questions.question: What happened when Aaron threw down his staff before Pharaoh?
options: It bloomed with ripe almonds as a sign
It became a serpent and swallowed the magicians' staffs
It withered and crumbled into dust before all
It turned the whole palace floor into a sheet of red blood
questions.answer: It became a serpent and swallowed the magicians' staffs

questions.question: Pharaoh's heart was hardened and he would not listen to Moses and Aaron.
Aaron stretched out his hand, and the water of the Nile turned to _____.
God said he had made Moses like _____ to Pharaoh, with Aaron as his prophet.
